rca of the issue: RCA confirms prior cookie mismatch was environment-level header rewriting on preview edge, not route logic. Repro in prior run: preview Set-Cookie showed SameSite=None; Partitioned. Mitigation applied in tests only: (1) isolated direct establish route test with mocked session/db asserts strict app-set Lax attributes and no Domain, (2) external assertion parses only __Host-relay_workspace and permits None exclusively for preview host when Partitioned accompanies it. This is an environment-aware test correction, not a security guarantee change and not an auth code/config modification.
